task: Finish local dataset readiness and prepare Source Cooperative products

source_access.gdw: Retain prior HTTP 403 evidence; retry official routes with bounded metadata/range requests. Only acquire and checksum a complete source if available and storage preflight passes.
source_access.swot: Use recorded v2.03 inventory and checksum-verified AU_55 sample gate. No full global conversion before a bounded streaming/retention plan is qualified.

storage.rule: No deletions of existing files, threshold reductions, or killing unrelated work. Prefer existing analytic assets and metadata-only enhancements. New report paths must be unused.

gates: Demonstrate an actual browser view of queried analytic data, not a pre-rendered thumbnail.
Record exact local asset hashes and bounded query/HTTP evidence. Preserve analytic files; label simplified display geometry and any sampling.
A local render demonstration does not satisfy public-host browser validation. Preserve failures and incomplete coverage.
Use the retained producer documentation as authority for field meanings, units, aggregations and upstream data attribution.
Map every producer field or explicitly mark unresolved meaning; never infer a source license.
Do not rewrite immutable releases. Version metadata enhancements separately and bind them to unchanged analytic hashes.
Check polygon and pour-point field coverage and preserve all earlier scientific/rebuild evidence.

source_products.owner_preference: nthh, subject to verified Source Cooperative account access
gates: Keep canonical product intent in datasets/<id>/dataset.yaml; generated descriptions and plans are views.
Bind every planned uploaded asset to its exact existing package path, byte size and SHA-256; reject traversal, credentials, missing files, mutable overrides and duplicate keys.
Distinguish proposed destinations from confirmed account/product routes. Do not set public URLs or published status before actual verification.
Product descriptions include producer credit, license, edition, geographic and temporal scope, formats, validation limits and related datasets.
Product creation may proceed only if authorized account and scope are established. Preparing products does not imply bulk upload, Git push or registry submission.

verification: Focused tests for new preparation tools and failure controls.
Regenerate and check canonical inventory and publication catalog.
Clean-checkout rehearsal of generated product drafts and offline tests.
Commit locally; preserve unrelated changes and all prior release evidence.
